description: This file defines an in-memory store for managing the state and configuration of an embedded iframe component, including routing, styles, event tracking, and view management.

methods.name: resetPageData
methods.description: Resets all page-specific embed state data, including event flags and reload initiation status.

methods.name: getPageDataProp
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property from the embed store's pageData in a type-safe manner.

methods.name: setPageDataProp
methods.description: Sets a specific property in the embed store's pageData in a type-safe manner.

methods.name: getEventHasFired
methods.description: Checks if a specific embed event has been fired.

methods.name: setEventHasFired
methods.description: Marks a specific embed event as fired or not.

methods.name: getReloadInitiated
methods.description: Checks if a reload has been initiated.

methods.name: setReloadInitiated
methods.description: Marks that a reload has been initiated.

methods.name: incrementView
methods.description: Increments the view ID counter for tracking different embed views.
